meta.title: AIC Console Theme
meta.description: A restrained engineering-console theme: neutral near-black surfaces, hairline structure, one accent colour, real session telemetry and disposable instrument extensions.

ui.densityNote: Adjust telemetry spacing while retaining readable text sizes.
ui.effectsNote: Accent details for selection, rules and controls. The run notice option controls the bottom light.
ui.readoutNote: Show actual run state, session identity and loaded records.
ui.intensityNote: Use only the current model's supported effort levels.
ui.fontNote: This software uses HarmonyOS Sans SC (Copyright 2021 Huawei Device Co., Ltd.). Original fonts and their licence are bundled; installed faces are reused when available. JetBrains Mono and Rajdhani are also bundled. Bahnschrift uses a local face.
ui.preferenceNote: Settings are stored in this browser. Appearance still controls light, dark and system mode; switching a palette only changes the accent colour.
ui.selectionFailed: Could not change the effort. Try again.
ui.loadedWindow: Statistics cover loaded session records only, not the complete history.
ui.activityNote: Tool calls and files being changed, derived from loaded session records.
ui.noData: Session data is not available yet.
ui.noEvents: No records yet. Session activity will appear here.
ui.ringDescription: Type distribution of loaded session records. Use the buttons below to filter or read the event list directly.
ui.ringNote: Arcs encode record type; links connect adjacent records in the same turn; ray length encodes records per turn. Dense histories are sampled evenly.
ui.turnNote: Each cell is a loaded turn. Red borders indicate error records. Other cells do not imply success. Up to 120 recent turns are shown.
ui.decorationNote: Structural dividers, corner brackets and panel indices at low contrast.
ui.motionNote: Animate new-session background feedback, bottom emission, effort ticks and refresh indicators.
ui.sidebarNote: Native project/session hierarchy with ordinal index, hairlines and relative time.
ui.turnRailNote: A hairline axis in the transcript gutter with absolute turn numbers and the current position.
ui.runFxNote: Show run notices and the bottom light: grey while idle, with the current primary theme colour glowing upward while running.
ui.balanceNote: Use the existing signed-in account. No extra API key.
ui.previewFx: Visual preview · does not start or stop an Agent
ui.sessionListNote: Session rows show relative time and the selected marker.
ui.agentStartedMessage: Session execution has started; runtime state is now live.
ui.agentStartedSub: Agent started. Runtime state is now live.
ui.agentStoppedMessage: Session execution has ended; runtime state is released.
ui.sloganNote: Shown at the right of the page-tab row; fully customisable.
ui.titleNameNote: Used in the brand, headings, composer and loader. Up to 32 characters.
ui.centerChatNote: Centre message bubbles; turn off to restore the host alignment.
ui.composerStripNote: Title, looping silver glow, current session id and state; not task progress.
ui.bootWaitForInputNote: Wait for a key or click after the completion animation; otherwise enter automatically.
ui.bootContinue: Press any key or click to continue
